لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَت رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
transliteration:
Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil ard; wa in tubdoo maa fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihil laa; fayaghfiru li mai-yashaaa'u wa yu'azzibu mai-yashaaa'u; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa unzila ilaihi mir-Rabbihee wal mu'minoon; kullun aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikathihee wa Kutubhihee wa Rusulihee laa nufarriqu baina ahadim-mir-Rusulih wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaikal-maseer
Laa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa; lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat; Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhiznaa in naseenaa aw akhtaanaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-'alainaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
translation: To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Whether you reveal what is in your hearts or conceal it, Allah will call you to account for it. He forgives whoever He wills, and punishes whoever He wills. And Allah is Most Capable of everything.                                                                                                     The Messenger firmly believes in what has been revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. They all believe in Allah, His angels, His Books, and His messengers. They proclaim, “We make no distinction between any of His messengers.” And they say, “We hear and obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord! And to You alone is the final return.”                                                                            Allah does not require of any soul more than what it can afford. All good will be for its own benefit, and all evil will be to its own loss. The believers pray, “Our Lord! Do not punish us if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord! Do not place a burden on us like the one you placed on those before us. Our Lord! Do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our only Guardian. So grant us victory over the disbelieving people.”

arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي، لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
title: Tauheed
situation: Dua for times of grief and worry
transliteration: Allahu Allahu Rabbi, laa ushriku bihi shay'an
translation: Allah alone is my Rabb; I do not associate with him anything.
tafsir:
Hazrat Asma Binti Umais R.A narrates that the Prophet S.A.W said to me "Shall I not inform you of such words which you can recite at the time of difficulty?" The Prophet S.A.W then taught her the above dua. 
(Abu Dawud Shareef)

arabic: لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلا بِاللَّهِ
title: Testimony
situation: Dua for times of grief and worry
transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illa billahi
translation: There is no power or strength except with Allah.
tafsir: It has been mentioned in the hadith that this is a cure for 99 illnesses, the least of which is worry and grief. (Hisne Haseen)

arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
title: Mercy
situation: Dua for times of grief and worry
transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoomu birahmatika astagheeth
translation: O Eternal Living, O sustainer of all the creations, from your mercy alone I seek help.
tafsir: Hazrat Anas R.A narrates that when the Prophet S.A.W would get worried about something, he would recite this dua

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
title: Glorification of Allah (magnificence)
situation: Dua for times of grief and worry
transliteration: Subhanallahil azeem wa bi hamdihi
translation: Glory be to Allah, the Great, and praise be to Him.
tafsir: In a narration, Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A narrates that the Prophet S.A.W on occasions of worry would look up to the skies and recite this dua.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاءُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ بَصَرِي، وَشِفَاءَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي وَغَمِّي.
title: Tranquility
situation: Dua for achieving peace and tranquility
transliteration: Allahumma inni abduka, wabnu abdika wabnu amatika, naasiyatee biyadika, maadhin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qadhaa'uka, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika, awista'tharta bihi fi ilmil ghaybi indaka, an taj'alal Qur'aanal azeema rabee'a qalbee, wa noora basaree wa shifaa sadree, wa jalaa'a huznee, wa zahaaba hammi wa ghammi.
translation: O Allah, I am your servant and the son of your servant and the son of your female servant, my forehead is in your hands, only your order works in me, and your judgement in regards to me is just. I beseech you with all the names which are for you, which you have named or revealed in your book, or which you have taught anyone from your creation, or which you have kept in the knowledge of the unseen by you. I ask you that you make the glorious Quran the enlightenment for my heart, and a source of light for my eyes, and a cure for my chest, and the removal of my worry and grief.
tafsir: It has been mentioned in a hadith that if a person who has been afflicted with worry or grief recites this dua, Allah S.W.T will change his worry and grief into happiness. A person asked, "O! Prophet of Allah the one who does not remember this dua is indeed in great loss." The Prophet S.A.W replied "Yes, most certainly" he further stated, "Therefore, recite this dua yourself and also teach it to others aswell." (Ibn Sunni)

arabic: عُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ وَسُلْطَانِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُو
title: Protection from evil (seeking refuge)
situation: Dua for pain and illness
transliteration: A'oozu bi-izzatillahi wa qudratihi, wa sultanihi min sharri ma ajidu
translation: I seek refuge in the Might, Power, and Authority of Allah from the evil that I find.
tafsir: A sahabee narrates that: One day, a certain part of my body was giving me extreme pain due to which I came close to dying. I came to the Prophet (S.A.W). The Prophet S.A.W said to me, 'Stroke your right hand over the place which is hurting, then recite this dua 7 times (which has been mentioned above).' The sahabee says, I did as the Prophet S.A.W told me and Allah S.W.T removed the pain. After this, I used to instruct my family members and others of this same practice. (Tirmidhi Shareef)

arabic: رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ، تَقَدَّسَ اسْمُكَ، أَمْرُكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ، كَمَا رَحْمَتُكَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، فَاجْعَلْ رَحْمَتَكَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، اغْفِرْ لَنَاحُوْبَنَا وَخَطَايَانَاأَنْتَ رَبُّ الطَّيِّبِينَ، أَنْزِلْ رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَشِفَاءً مِنْ شِفَائِكَ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَجْهِ
title: Healing
situation: Dua for pain and illness
transliteration: Rabbunallahal-lazi fis-samaa'ee taqaddasa ismuka, amruka fis-samaa'ee wal ardhi kamaa rahmatuka fis-samaa'ee faj'al rahmataka fil ardhi, ighfir lanaa hoobanaa wa khataayaanaa, anta Rabbut-tayyibeena, anzil rahmatan-min rahmatika, wa shifa'an-min shifaa'ika alaa haazal waj'ee
translation: Our Lord, Allah, who is in the heavens, sanctified be Your name. Your command reigns in the heavens and the earth, as Your mercy is in the heavens, so make Your mercy manifest on earth. Forgive our sins and mistakes. You are the Lord of the righteous. Send down a mercy from Your mercy and a cure from Your cure upon this ailment.
tafsir: It has been mentioned in the hadith that the Prophet S.A.W said that whosoever from you experiences pain, or someone complains to you about their pain, then recite the dua and blow onto him. (Abu Dawud)

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْأَحَدِ الصَّمَدِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَجِدُو
title: Protection from evil (uniqueness of Allah)
situation: Dua for pain and illness
transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim u'eezuka billahil ahadis-samadil-lazi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun-lahu kufuwan ahad, min sharri maa tajidu
translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. I seek refuge in Allah, the One, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent, from the evil that you find.
tafsir:
Hazrat Uthman R.A. reports that : When I fell ill, the Prophet S.A.W blew on me with the above dua and when the Prophet S.A.W was leaving, he said "O Uthman, blow in this
manner, you will have not come across such
blowing?" (Ibn Sunni)

arabic: اذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءٌ لَا يُغَادرُ سَقَمًا
title: Recovery from illness
situation: Dua for pain and illness
transliteration: Azhibil ba'sa Rabban-naasi ishfi antash-shaafi laa shifaa'a illa shifaa'uka shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqama
translation: Remove the hardship, O Lord of mankind, and cure, for You are the Healer. There is no cure except Your cure; a cure that does not leave any illness.
tafsir: Pray this and blow onto the sick. (Abu Dawud)

arabic: تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ، وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا
title: Trust in Allah
situation: Dua for a person who becomes frail due to severe illness or difficulty
transliteration: Tawakkaltu a'lal hayyil-lazi laa yamootu, Alhamdulillahil-lazi lam yattakhiz wa lada, wa lam yakun-lahu shareekun fil mulki wa lam yakun-lahu waliyyum minaz-zulli wa kabbirhu takbeera
translation: I have placed my trust in the Ever-Living, who does not die. Praise be to Allah, who has not taken a son, and has no partner in dominion. Nor does He have a protector out of weakness. And magnify Him with all magnificence.
tafsir: It has been mentioned in a hadith narrated by Abu Hurairah R.A that once I came out with the Prophet S.A.W in such a manner that my hand was in Prophet S.A.W's hand. We came across a person who was very feeble and weak. Prophet S.A.W inquired about this condition of his; he replied, sickness has made me so. Prophet S.A.W said, Shall I tell you of such words with which all pains and difficulties are removed? Make a habit of reciting this (above dua). The narrator says that after some days, the Prophet S.A.W happened to come accross him again and his condition had become better. When the Prophet S.A.W enquired, he said I continued reciting the dua which you taught me. In a different narration, the Prophet S.A.W said: Whenever some difficulty came to me, Angel Jibraeel A.S would appear and say O! Muhammad recite this and recite this at the end (Roohul Maani).

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحُزْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
title: Worry and grief
situation: Dua for removal of worry and grief and fulfilment of debt
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'oozu bika minal hammi wal huzni, wa a'oozu bika minal ajzi walkasali, wa a'oozu bika minal jubni wal bukhli, wa a'oozu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijaal
translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and sorrow, and I seek refuge in You from weakness and laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice and stinginess, and I seek refuge in You from the burden of debt and from the overpowering of men.
tafsir: Once the Prophet S.A.W entered the masjid and he saw Abu Umamah R.A sitting there. The Prophet S.A.W inquired "O! Abu Umamah, Why are you seated here unusually?" (It was not namaaz time). He replied that great worry and grief and debts have encircled me, upon this the Prophet S.A.W said, "Shall I not inform you of a dua? If you recite it, Allah S.W.T will remove your worries and fulfil your debts." He said most certainly. The Prophet S.A.W told him to recite this dua in the morning and evening and Abu Ummah says I practiced upon this and Allah removed my worries and fulfilled my debts. (Abu Dawud Shareef)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّكفِنِي بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
title: Contentment and independance
situation: Dua for removal of worry and grief and fulfilment of debt
transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalaalika an haraamika, wa aghninee bifadhlika amman siwaaka
translation: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your grace from all other sources.
tafsir: In one narration it has been mentioned that an extremely needy person came to Hazrat Ali R.A and said to him, I will teach you such words which the Prophet S.A.W taught me that even if you have debts equal to a mountain, Allah Ta'ala will fulfill them. (Tirmidhi Shareef)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قضِعَنِالدَّيْنَوَأَغْنِنِي مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
title: Debt
situation: Dua for removal of worry and grief and fulfilment of debt
transliteration: Allahummaqdhi annid-dayna wa aghninee minal faqri
translation: O Allah, fulfil my debts and change my poverty into richness.

arabic: للهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
title: Acknowledging Allah's power
situation: Dua for removal of worry and grief and fulfilment of debt
transliteration: Allahu lateefum bi-ibaadihi yarzuqu ma'in yashaa'u wa huwal Qawwiyul-Azeez
translation: Allah is Kind to His servants; He provides for whom He wills. And He is the Strong, the Mighty.

arabic:
أَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ 
تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ أَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَتَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدِرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي وَا بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ أَللَّهُم وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفينِيْ عَنْهُ وَاصْرِفهُعَنِّي وَاقْدِرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهُ
title: Decision-making
situation: Dua for istikhara
transliteration:
Allahumma inni astakheeruka bi-ilmika wa astaqdiruka wa as'aluka min
fadhlikal-azeem, fa innaka taqdiru wa laa aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wa laa aa'lamu, wa anta allaamul ghuyoob, Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna haazal amra khairun li fi deeni wa ma'ashi wa aaqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li, wa barik li fihi, Allahumma wa in kunta ta'lamuhu sharran li fi deeni wa ma'ashi wa aaqibati amri fasrifni anhu wasrifhu anni, waqdur liyal khaira haythu kaana summa radhdhini bihi
translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, and I seek Your power through Your capability, and I ask You from Your immense favor, for You have the power and I have no power. You have the knowledge and I have no knowledge, and You know the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter (mention your matter here) is good for my religion, my livelihood, and the consequences of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for my religion, my livelihood, and the consequences of my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it. And decree for me the good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.
tafsir: It was narrated that Jabir bin ‘Abdullah said the Prophet used to teach us Istikharah, just as he used to teach us a Surah of the Qur’an. He said: ‘If anyone of you is deliberating about a decision he has to make, then let him pray two Rak’ah of non- obligatory prayer, then recite this dua.' (Sunan Ibn Majah)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّخِرْ لِيوَاخْتَرْ لِي
title: Seeking Allah's choice
situation: Short istikhara
transliteration: Allahumma khirli wakhtarli
translation: O Allah, choose and select for me.
tafsir: Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.A reports that when the Prophet S.A.W intended some task, he would say "O Allah, choose for me and select for me (what is better for me)." (Tirmidhi Shareef)

arabic: أَللّٰهُمَّ أَلْهِمْنِىْ رُشْدِىْ وَ أَعِذْنِىْ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِىْ
title: Seeking goodness and protection from evil
situation: Short istikhara
transliteration: Allahumma alhimni rushdi wa a'izni min sharri nafsi
translation: O Allah, inspire in my heart goodness and protect me from the evil of my desires.
tafsir: Hazrat Imran Bin Hussain R.A reports that the Prophet S.A.W said to my father Hussain, "If you embrace Islam, I shall teach you a dua which shall benefit you." When he embraced Islam, he requested the Prophet S.A.W to teach him the dua.            (Tirmidhi Shareef)

arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ, لَا تَأْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ يَا حَيُّ 
يَا قَيُّومُ أَهْدِئْ لَيْلِي وَأَنِمْ عَيْنِي
title: Peaceful sleep
situation: When not able to go to sleep
transliteration: Allahumma gharatin nujoomu, wa hada-a'til u'yoonu, wa anta hayyun qayyoomun laa ta'quzuka sinatun-wala naum, ya Yayyu ya Qayyuoomu, ahdi' layli wa anim ayni
translation: O Allah, the stars have disappeared, eyes have taken rest, You are the eternal living and the sustainer of every thing. Neither you sleep, nor does slumber overtake you. O! Eternal living, controller of everything, make the night peaceful for me and make my eyes go to sleep.
tafsir: Hazrat Zaid Bin Thabit R.A narrates that I complained to the Prophet S.A.W of lack of sleeping. The Prophet S.A.W told me to recite this dua. He further says that when I practiced this, Allah S.W.T removed my complain. (Kitaabul Azkaar)

arabic: اللهُمَّ لا سَهْلَ إلا مَا جَعَلتَهُ سَهْلا وَ أنتَ تَجْعَلُ الحزْنَسَهْل إذا شِئْتَ ا
title: Seeking Allah's help
situation: When faced with a difficult situation
transliteration: Allahumma laa sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul hazna sahlan iza shi'ta
translation: O Allah, there is nothing easy except what You make easy, and You can make the difficult easy if You will.
tafsir: Hazrat Anas R.A reports that whenever some difficult situation would arise, the Prophet S.A.W would read this dua. The Prophet S.A.W prescribed this dua for his ummah to make difficult matters easy for all times.

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَاوَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ يُغْشِى ٱلَّيْلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُۥ حَثِيثًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۭ بِأَمْرِهِ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلْخَلْقُ وَٱلْأَمْرتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًۭا وَخُفْيَةً  إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينوَلَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَـٰحِهَا وَٱدْعُوهُ خَوْفًۭا وَطَمَعًا إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
title: Birth
situation: Dua for ease when giving birth
transliteration: Inna Rabbakumullahul lazi khalaqas samaawaati wal ardha fi sittati ayyamin summas-tawaa a'lal arshi yughshil-laylan-nahaara yatlubuhu  hathithan wash-shamsa wal qamara wan-nujooma musakkharaatim bi amrihi a'laa lahul khalqu wal amru tabaarakallahu Rabbul Aalameen, ud'ou Rabbakum tadharru'an-wa khufyatan innahu laa yuhibbul mu'tadeen, wa laa tufsidoo fil ardhi ba'da islaahiha wad'oohu khawfan-wa tama'an inna Rahmatallahi qareebun-minal muhsineen
translation: Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, seeking it rapidly, and the sun, the moon, and the stars are subjected to His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command. Blessed is Allah, Lord of all the worlds. Call upon your Lord in humility and privately. Indeed, He does not like transgressors. And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.
tafsir: Hazrat Fatima, the daughter of Prophet S.A.W, narrates that when the time of delivering a child came close, the Prophet S.A.W instructed Hazrat Umme Salama R.A and Hazrat Zainab R.A both to go to Hazrat Fatima R.A and recite the whole of ayatul kursi, this dua and also the Muawazatain and then blow on her.

arabic: اللهُمَّ رَادَّ الضَّالَّةِ، وَهَادِيَ الضَّلَالَةِ تَهْدِي مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، ارْدُدْ عَلَيَّ ضَالَّتِي بِقُدْرَتِكِ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ عَطَائِكَ وَفَضْلِكَ
title: Return from misguidance
situation: Dua for lost item or person
transliteration: Allahumma raaddadh-dhaallati, wa haadiyadh-dhalaalati anta tahdi minadh-dhalaalati, urdud alayya dhuaallati bi qudratika wa sultaanika, fa innaha min ataaika wa fadhlika
translation: O Allah, you are the one who returns the lost and you are the one who gives guidance from misguidance, You are the one who shows the right way from going astray, return to me my lost object with your Power and Might because the blessing was only from your favours and grace.
tafsir: Hazrat Ibn Umar R.A reports that the Prophet S.A.W said, When something gets lost or someone runs away, pray the above dua for its return.

arabic: يا جامِعَ الناسِ لِيَوْمٍ لا رَيْبَ فِيهِ، اجْمَعْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ ضَلالَتِي
title: Gathering
situation: Dua for lost item or person
transliteration: Ya jaamee'an-naasi li yawmil-laa rayba feehi ijma' bayni wa bayna dhallati
translation: O gatherer of mankind on the Day in which there is no doubt, bring about consensus between me and my opponents.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا يَأْتِي بِالْحَسَنَاتِ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَلَا يَدْفَعُ السَّيِّئَاتِ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
title: Goodness and righteousness
situation: When faced with some unfavourable situation or its fear
transliteration: Allahumma la ya'ti bil hasanaati illa anta, wa laa yadfa'us-sayyi'aati illa anta, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illa bika
translation: O Allah, none can bring forth good deeds except You, and none can repel evil deeds except You. There is no power and no strength except with You.
tafsir: When a person sees something unpleasant and distasteful, he should recite this dua. (Ibn Sunni)

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
title: Refuge from evil of creations
situation: When faced with some unfavourable situation or its fear
transliteration: A'oozu bikalimaatillahit-taammaati min sharri ma khalaqa
translation: I seek refuge with the complete qualities of Allah S.W.T from all the evil of his creation.
tafsir: A Sahabiyah R.A reports that the Prophet S.A.W said, Whosoever descends on someplace and recites this dua, nothing shall harm him till he returns from that place. (Tirmidhi)

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
title: Calamity
situation: When afflicted with great calamity
transliteration: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illa billahil aliyyil azeem
translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. There is no power or strength except by Allah, the Exalted, the Mighty.
tafsir:
Hazrat Ali R.A narrates that Once the Prophet S.A.W said to me "O Ali, shall I not teach you such words that when you are afflicted with a calamity, you recite them?" He replied: Most
certainly, may I be sacrificed upon you. Upon this the Prophet S.A.W taught him the above words and said "Through the blessings of these words, Allah S.W.T will remove whatever
calamity he wishes to remove." (Ibn Sunni)

arabic: يَا مَالِكَ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
title: Assistance
situation: When one sees his enemy or fear of that
transliteration: Ya maalika yawmid-deeni iyyaaka a'abudu wa iyyaaka asta'een
translation: O the king of the day of judgement, only you I worship and from you only I seek assistance and from you only I seek help.
tafsir: Anas R.A reports that Once we were with Rasulullah S.A.W on a journey when enemy approached us. I heard the Prophet S.A.W reading this dua on the occasion and I saw the enemy retreating, they were getting beaten back by the angels from the front and also from the back. (Ibn Sunni)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
title: Fear of enemies
situation: When one sees his enemy or fear of that
transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim wa na'oozu bika min shururihim
translation: O Allah, we place you forward in defence from our enemies, and we seek your refuge from their evil.
tafsir: It has been mentioned in a hadith that when the Prophet S.A.W would perceive threat from a group of people, he would recite this dua.

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونَ
title: Refuge from evil
situation: Dua for a person faced with fear and when one is frightened
transliteration:
A'oozu bikalimaatillahit-taammati min ghadhabihi wa iqaabihi wa sharri
ibaadihi wa min hamazaatish-shayaateeni wa a'in-yahdhuroon
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect qualities of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the harmful whispers of the devils and their presence.
tafsir: A Sahabi R.A said to the Prophet S.A.W that I become afraid and frightened a lot. Prophet S.A.W said, when you go to sleep recite this dua. Another sahabee complained to the Prophet S.A.W with the same problem. The Prophet S.A.W said keep reciting this dua excessively.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ، رَبِّ المَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِجَلَّلْتَسَمَاوَاتوَالْأَرْضَبِالْعِزَّةِ وَالْجَبَرُوتِ
title: Glorification of Allah
situation: Dua for a person faced with fear and when one is frightened
transliteration: Subhaanal malikil quddoosi, Rabbil malaa'ikati war-roohi jallaltas-samaawaati wal ardha bil izzati wal jabarooti
translation: Glory be to the king who is pure, The rabb of all the angels and Hazrat Jibraeel A.S, and who has encircled the heavens and the earth with his might and power.

arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، أَسْأَلُكَ مُجِيبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَظَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ، وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ اسْمٍ، لَا تَدَعْزَنْبًاإِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ، وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ، وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
title: Need for guidance
situation: Dua for Salaatul Haajah
transliteration: Laa ilaaha illal laahul Haleemul Kareem, Subhaanallahi Rabbil arshil azeem, Alhamdulillahi Rabbil aalameen, as' aluka moojibaati rahmatika wa azaa'ima maghfiratika, wal ghanimata min kulli birrin was-salaamata min kulli ismin, la tada'li zamban illa ghafartahu, wa la hamman illa farraj tahu, wa la haajatan hiya laka ridhan illa qadhaytaha ya Arhamar-Raahimeen
translation: There is no deity except Allah, the Forbearing, the Generous. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the Mighty Throne. All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds. I ask You for the fulfillment of Your mercy, and the greatness of Your forgiveness, and the abundance of all good, and safety from all sins. Do not leave a sin of mine without forgiving it, nor a worry without relieving it, nor a need of mine that pleases You, without fulfilling it, O Most Merciful of the Merciful.
tafsir: The Prophet S.A.W has mentioned if someone has a special need or necessity from Allah S.W.T or from anyone, he should perform wudhu properly and perform 2 rakaat namaaz, then glorify and praise Allah and send salutations to Rasulullah S.A.W. Then read the above dua. (Tirmidhi Shareef)

arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةًۭ وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana aatina fid dunya hasanatan wa fil aa'khirati hasanatan wa-qina azaaban-naar
translation: Our Lord! Grant us the good of this world and the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اللَّهُمَّ حَوِّلْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَٰذَا وَطَوِّعْ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ، وَمِنَ الْهَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ
title: Travelling
situation: When travelling
transliteration: Subhanallazi sakhkhara lana haaza wa maa kunna lahu muqrineen, wa inna ilaa Rabbina lamunqaliboon, Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina haazal birrawat-taqwa, wa minal amali maa tardha, Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana haaza, watwi anna bu'dahu,  Allahumma antas-saahibu fis-safari, wal khalifatu fil ahli, Allahumma inni a'oozu bika min wa'thaa'is-safari wa ka'aabatil manzari, wa soo'il munqalabi fil maali wal ahli, wa minal howri ba'dal kaur
translation: Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, and we could not have it in our control. Indeed, to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in our journey, and from our deeds that which pleases You. O Allah, make our journey easy for us, and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are our companion on the journey and the guardian of our family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from having a difficult sight, and from an unfavorable return in wealth and family, and from encountering evil upon returning home.
tafsir: Hazrat Ibne Umar R.A narrates that when the Prophet S.A.W would mount on a conveyer to go somewhere, he would say Allahu Akbar 3 times. Then he would pray the above dua and when returning he would also recite this dua and add this "Aa'iboona taaiboona aabidoona lirabbina haamidoona"       (Muslim Shareef)

arabic: أَئِيبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
transliteration: Aa'iboona taaiboona aabidoona lirabbina haamidoona
translation: We return repentant to our Lord, worshiping our Lord and praising our Lord.

arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
title: Blessings
situation: Dua for the groom after nikaah
transliteration: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka alayka, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayrin
translation: May Allah bless you and bestow His blessings upon you, and may He unite you both in goodness.
tafsir: The Prophet S.A.W would give this dua to the person who would get married. (Bukhari & Muslim)

arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ
transliteration: Baarakallahu laka
translation: May Allah bless you.

arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ
transliteration: Baarakallahu alayka
translation: May Allah bless you.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
title: Seeking goodness of wife
situation: When meeting your wife for the first time
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khairaha wa khaira maa jabaltaha alayhi, wa a'oozo bika min sharriha wa sharri maa jabaltaha alayhi
translation:
O Allah, I ask you the good of this lady and the good of what you created her upon and I seek your refuge from her evil and
from the evil you created her upon.
tafsir: The Prophet S.A.W has mentioned when one of you gets married, he should get hold of the hair of the forehead of his wife gently and recite this dua. (Abu Dawud Shareef)

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
title: Grace and favour
situation: When one hears sound of a cockerel
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadhlika
translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
tafsir: The Prophet S.A.W said, When you hear the sound of a cockerel ask Allah's mercy because it has seen an angel at that time.

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
title: Seeking refuge
situation: When one hears sound of a dog of a donkey
transliteration: A'oozu billahi minash-shaytaanir rajeem
translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.
tafsir: The Prophet S.A.W said, When you hear the sound of dogs or donkeys, then seek Allah's refuge because at that time they have seen Satan. And in one narration it has been mentioned that these animals see what you do not see. (Sahihain)

arabic: أُعِيذُكَ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلتَّـٰمَّةِ مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ وَهَمَّةٍ وَمِن كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَّامَّةٍ
title: Protection from evil eye
situation: For the protection from evil glance or witchcraft and black magic
transliteration: U'eezuka bikalimaatil-laahit-taammati min kulli shaytanin wa haammah, wa min kulli aynin laammah
translation: I seek refuge in You with the perfect qualities of Allah from every devil and harmful creature, and from every evil eye.
tafsir:
Hazrat Ibne Abbas R.A reports that the Prophet S.A.W would recite this dua and blow on Hazrat Hassan R.A and Hussain R.A and he would say that Hazrat Ibrahim A.S would also
blow upon his two sons Ismail and Ishaaq A.S.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ وَعَيْنٍ حَاسِدَةٍ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، وَاللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ
title: Protection from evil (envy)
situation: For the protection from evil glance or witchcraft and black magic
transliteration: Bismillahi arqeeka, min kulli shayin yu'zeek, min sharri kulli nafsin wa aynin haasidat, Bismillahi arqeeka, wallahu yashfeek
translation: In the name of Allah, I seek refuge in You from everything that harms you. From the evil of every soul and envious eye. In the name of Allah, I seek refuge in You, and Allah will protect you.
tafsir: Abu Saeed Kudri R.A narrates that Hazrat Jibraeel A.S came to the Prophet S.A.W and asked "Are you not feeling well?" The Prophet S.A.W replied in the affirmative. Upon this, he recited this dua and blew on the Prophet S.A.W. (Muslim & Tirmidhi)

arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
title: Allah's will
situation: For the protection from evil glance or witchcraft and black magic
transliteration: Maasha Allahu la quwwata illa billahi
translation: Everything happens with the will of Allah, without his help we have no power over anything.
tafsir:
Hazrat Anas R.A narrates that the Prophet S.A.W said, A person who says Mashallah upon the blessings which Allah has favoured him with upon his wealth, children, family, no calamity shall befall on these blessings until death. Meaning, all his blessings shall be
saved from calamities; or one could say besides death, no other calamity shall befall him. Death is inevitable.(Ibn Sunni)
